Do It for the Kids

Let's just get this out of the way, up front. I'm asking for a little bit of your time and a little bit of your money. Fifty bucks, and a few hours. But it's for a good cause, and you get free drinks and snacks. Where, when? At the Dyer Library and Saco Museum Festival of Trees Preview Gala Nov. 21, 6:00-9:00 PM Why there? I am on the board of trustees, and this is our biggest fundraiser. Yes, I'm a little on the late side with asking you, I'll do better next year.

Here's my pitch. Libraries are awesome (museums are fine). From the Kellogg-Hubbard in Central Vermont, to the Cambridge Public Library, and now the Dyer Library, I've been happy to treat my local library as a third space. My kids are currently setting records in both reading voracity, and late fees. Louise is constantly finding new books in her favorite genre (terrible things happen to nice people). I've been having fun hacking my e-reader to make it work with Dyer's e-books. The current administration even tried to revoke funding to the U.S. Institute of Museum and Library Services, so you know libraries are doing something right. So please buy a ticket and join Louise and I on a festive night for a great cause.
